source.preview_text_exact:
Instagram
DM your course like a closer
Business value
No more scrambling with link in bio changes or missed DMs. Just clean, fast, scalable launch momentum. Your products show up in DMs like magic, and so do the sales.
How does it work?

Use Manychat to send product info when someone DMs a keyword (like "new drop"). Update your product gallery in a few clicks and let the automation do the rest.
